notes.title: September 9 Update Notice – Cloud Save is Here!
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Cloud save functionality is now available! (Please update to the latest version.)
[/olist]
If the opening cinematic replays for you, head to the Roadmap to check whether your save data is intact.

notes.title: August 31 Update Patch
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain scene choices would behave abnormally.
[*] Fixed a bug during Su Su’s character introduction that caused two character profiles to appear for some players.
[*] Resolved the problem where the game’s BGM would disappear after the ending sequence.
[/olist]

notes.title: August 30 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where some players encountered a black screen and could not proceed after the "再临" chapter.
Fixed the issue where the "游戏开始" achievement could not be unlocked. Return to the route map and replay the first section of Chapter One to unlock it.

notes.title: August 29th Update Patch
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the screen would go black and prevent further gameplay after the Shiale storyline
[*] Resolved screen compatibility issues for certain resolutions
[/olist]
